name: hyperdot token consumption benchmark
description: Tokens, cost and time an agent spends on typical questions and changes in this repository, under three ways of working.

profiles.description: The task as asked; the agent finds its own way around the repository
Only the listed files, a concise answer, fewer turns
profiles.appendSystemPrompt: Read only the files named under Context, and only what the task needs. Answer as briefly as the task allows: no preamble, no restating the question, no closing summary.

profiles.description: A short plan first, then the answer, in the same session
steps: Before answering, list the files you will read and your plan in at most five bullets. Do not answer yet.
Now carry out the plan and give the answer, within the limits the task sets.

tasks.title: Explain the PowerShell test orchestration flow
tasks.prompt: Explain the end-to-end flow of `test` in this repository: the entry script, how the project and runners are detected, how Godot is invoked for each runner, and what files a run produces. Under 220 words.

tasks.title: Map the GDScript test structure
tasks.prompt: Summarize how the GDScript example's tests are organized, named and discovered, and how the kit runs them. Under 180 words.

tasks.title: Write a reusable test runner function in the repository's style
tasks.prompt: Write a minimal PowerShell function that runs one test runner and returns a structured result, following this repository's conventions in AGENTS.md (strict mode, how failures are reported, no Write-Output from helpers). Return code only.

tasks.title: Strengthen parameter validation
tasks.prompt: Propose a concise diff that strengthens validation of one parameter of ci/godot/hyperdot.ps1 that is not validated today (for example with ValidateRange or ValidatePattern). Return only the diff.

tasks.title: Diagnose hanging test runs
tasks.prompt: List the five most likely causes of a hanging test run in this repository's PowerShell orchestration, each with one concrete mitigation, naming the setting or code that already guards against it where one exists.

tasks.title: Diagnose flaky GDScript tests
tasks.prompt: Give five likely causes of flaky GDScript tests when this kit runs them in CI, each with one mitigation tailored to this repository. Under 240 words.

tasks.title: Reduce token use in AI-assisted CI
tasks.prompt: Recommend five concrete changes that would reduce token use and time when agents work in this repository, covering scoping context, prompt templates, caching and output size. Bullets only.

tasks.title: Propose a profile routing policy
tasks.prompt: Define a lightweight policy for when an agent working in this repository should use profile A-baseline, B-scoped or C-iterative (described in benchmark/token-benchmark.json), based on task type and risk, as if/then rules. Be concise.
